title_en: Free 6-Hour Live Webinar: ERP for OCD, the 2 Missing Pieces with Catherine M. Pittman
summary_zh: eCare Behavioral Health Institute 免費 6 小時直播。2026 年 12 月 15 日美東時間 10:00–17:30 線上舉行（港澳 12 月 15 日 23:00 至 12 月 16 日 06:30），由 Catherine M. Pittman 博士主講，分享喺暴露與反應預防（ERP）加入的兩項元素：杏仁核教育與動機目標，協助 OCD 個案建立做暴露練習的個人理由。
summary_en: A free 6-hour live webinar from eCare Behavioral Health Institute on 15 December 2026, 10:00am-5:30pm Eastern (23:00 Macau time on 15 December to 06:30 on 16 December), led by Catherine M. Pittman, PhD. It covers two additions she makes to exposure and response prevention (ERP) for OCD: amygdala education and motivating goals, helping clients find their own reason to start exposures.
